interface.shortDescription: Your brand's Styles, logos and assets in your AI app. Free to start.
interface.longDescription: Keep your brand's Styles, official logos and guides, and asset library in Blueprint Studio, shared with your team. Your AI app uses them to make on-brand icons, social graphics, hero images and slides, and saves each one to your library. Start free: set up your brand from your website, or start in your personal library with no setup. Optional skills cover a guided start, asset creation, brand administration and Style experiments.
